'''Puloorn''' was a [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]]. It was the site of an ancient, ruined [[Sith temple (Puloorn)|Sith temple]] that was inhabited both by creatures twisted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and by a group of cultists. At some point, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dispatched a team of agents on a [[Mission to Puloorn|mission]] to investigate the rumored existence of Puloorn's [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]].

Arriving on the planet in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the agents faced the hostile conditions of Puloorn before finally locating the temple. Inside the structure, the team faced the inhabitants of the ruins as well as its system of defenses, and the group eventually returned to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
Puloorn was a distant and isolated terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RCRB" /> located in the [[Puloorn system/Legends|Puloorn system]], a part of the [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]], [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered world. Drawn to the strong presence the planet's [[Sith temple (Puloorn)|Sith temple]] had in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], twisted, dark creatures had arrived there from off-world.<ref name="RCRB" />

==History==
At some point, a [[Sith temple/Legends|temple]] was built on Puloorn that was used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]],<ref name="RCRB" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] utilizing the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="CSWE Sith">{{CSWECite|III|154|Sith}}</ref> Long after that, the structure had become ruined and abandoned, and the final of a series of official survey reports of Puloorn did not acknowledge the presence of the temple at all. Eventually, a cultist group established its base of operations within the ruins.<ref name="RCRB" />

The circulation of rumors regarding the existence of the Sith temple on Puloorn led [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="RCRB" />&mdash;who was in reality the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>&mdash;to dispatch a team of agents on a [[Mission to Puloorn|mission]] to the planet<ref name="RCRB" /> at some point between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' establishes that the [[mission to Puloorn]] took place during [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] service as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the beginning and end point of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], respectively.</ref> The team included the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sia-Lan Wezz]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Deel Surool]], and the Human [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Vor'en Kurn]], and its task was to investigate the ruins of the temple on Puloorn. The team gathered what little information it could find on the planet, gathered the supplies necessary for the mission, and readied its [[Starship/Legends|starship]] for the long trip from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="RCRB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet that served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

{{RPG}}
When the Supreme Chancellor's team eventually arrived on Puloorn, it had to face the world's hostile conditions while locating the ruined temple. After finally confirming the existence of the structure, the agents entered the temple. Inside, the team faced the structure's defenses as well as the cultists and the creatures corrupted by the dark side of the Force that had all come to reside in the ruins. Eventually, the team concluded its mission, returned to its starship and traveled back to Coruscant.<ref name="RCRB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
An official survey report of Puloorn did not mention any inhabitants or signs of civilization on the planet, despite the presence of a Sith temple there. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Supreme Chancellor Palpatine dispatched agents to Puloorn, a group of cultists was using the ruins of the temple as a base.<ref name="RCRB" />

==Locations==
A ruined Sith temple with a dark interior was located on Puloorn. The structure was outfitted with a set of ancient defenses.<ref name="RCRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Puloorn was first mentioned in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|core rulebook]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, Puloorn is described as the setting for a mission in a hypothetical [[roleplaying game]] adventure. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described, with the player characters facing all the challenges suggested in the section featuring Puloorn.<ref name="CRB">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA Puloorn" />
